project_metadata.description: A synthesized domain model for an e-commerce system, structured by Bounded Contexts.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer accounts, their personal information, loyalty programs, and wishlists.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the system, including personal details, account information, and loyalty points.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of products saved by a customer for future consideration, referencing products from the Product Catalog.

value_objects.name: Address
value_objects.description: Represents a postal address, typically used for customer shipping and billing, providing location details.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product information, categories, and pricing for all items available for sale.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: An item available for sale, characterized by its unique identifier (SKU), name, description, price, images, specifications, and categories.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification for organizing products into a hierarchical taxonomy, allowing for nested categories.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary amount with its associated currency, used consistently for pricing and financial transactions across the system.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles the creation, processing, and lifecycle of customer orders, from placement to delivery.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer's request to purchase one or more products, encapsulating details like items, total amount, customer reference, and shipping/billing addresses.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific product and its quantity included within an order, referencing the product by SKU and storing the unit price at the time of purchase.

value_objects.name: OrderStatus
value_objects.description: Defines the current lifecycle state of an order (e.g., Pending, Confirmed, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled).

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the stock levels, reservations, and availability of products across different warehouses.

entities.name: StockItem
entities.description: Represents the current stock level, reserved quantity for pending orders, and reorder threshold for a specific product in a given warehouse.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles payment transactions, manages customer payment methods, and processes refunds, interacting with external payment gateways.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A record of a monetary transaction associated with an order, including status, amount, and the payment method used.

entities.name: PaymentMethod
entities.description: Details of how a customer prefers to pay (e.g., credit card, debit card, digital wallet), often saved for future use and associated with a customer.

value_objects.name: PaymentStatus
value_objects.description: Defines the current lifecycle state of a payment (e.g., Initiated, Completed, Failed, Refunded).

value_objects.name: PaymentMethodInfo
value_objects.description: Represents non-sensitive details of a payment method (e.g., card type, last four digits) for display or reference.
